question: Related Questions Q. Due to bad behavior with me and my 2 sons I verbally pronounced Talak thrice to my wife. The written talaknama was sent to my wife by speed post which she has refused to accept. Technically she claims to have not been divorced and her family members support her. I left my house immediately after this incident and have been living in a separate house with my 2 sons for the last 2 and half years. As per the Muslim law and the Sharia, is my Talak valid. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 5483 Country: India Title: My sister got married last year & after nine months of marriage her husband gave her Talaaq in writing. At that time she was pregnant but this was not known to her husband. Is the talaaq valid & is there any chances of reconciliation? Question: As salaam Alaikum, Respected Mufti saheb, my sister got married last year & after nine months of marriage her husband gave her Talaaq in writing. At that time she was pregnant but this was not known to her husband. Is the talaaq valid & is there any chances of reconciliation? Answer ID: 5483 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 465/421=L) Talaq can take place in the state of pregnancy; therefore if the abovementioned event is true then your sister was divorced. In case he wrote three divorces then there is no possibility of recovering except halala shariah. If he wrote one or two talaq (and he did not give any oral talaq before) then he can revoke it till the end of her iddah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
